items.title: How many tech-lead allies before the meeting actually move the odds?
items.description: Dev needs a majority of the 4 real decision-makers (the tech leads, not the VP who just defers to them) leaning his way before the meeting, not during it. Drag the slider to see how the odds of the decision going his way change as he secures more allies beforehand — notice this isn't a smooth line.

params.name: alliesSecured
params.label: Tech-lead allies secured before the meeting

items.compute: let odds = 10 + params.alliesSecured * 15; if (params.alliesSecured >= 3) { odds += 25; } odds = Math.min(odds, 92); return { odds };

outputs.label: Odds the decision goes Dev's way
